plugin.note: Standard Wyrms are safest when attacked outside melee range with Protect from Magic or a safespot. Dragonbane melee is viable; earth magic works on Wyrms and Wyrmlings, while water magic works on Lava and Magma Strykewyrms. Wyrmlings are a cannon alternative and Lava Strykewyrms are a 60 Sailing alternative.

requirements: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Bigger and Badder for Shadow Wyrm and Magma strykewyrm superior spawns
Can of Wyrms unlock for extended 200-250 assignments
Partial Perilous Moons progress for Wyrmlings in Neypotzli
60 Sailing and Charred Island access for Lava Strykewyrms
70 Construction for the optional Charred Island bank chest
mechanics: Wyrms are draconic and vulnerable to dragonbane weapons.
Standard Wyrms use melee and magic in melee range.
Attacking standard Wyrms outside direct melee range causes them to use only Magic.
Protect from Magic negates all damage from standard Wyrms when outside melee range.
Standard Wyrms have flat armour 1 and 50% earth elemental weakness.
Standard Wyrms cannot be cannoned in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
Wyrmlings use only melee, can be cannoned in Neypotzli, and cannot spawn Shadow Wyrm.
Lava Strykewyrms use melee and ranged; at distance they use only ranged, so Protect from Missiles is the defensive prayer.
Lava and Magma Strykewyrms have 50% water elemental weakness and cannot be cannoned.
Lava Strykewyrms heal from fire spells.
Magma strykewyrm can burrow to the player's location and hit 20+ if the player does not move.

methods.label: Requirements and unlocks
methods.summary: Prepare 62 Slayer, Karuulm heat protection, Can of Wyrms extension, and alternative-location requirements before routing the task.
steps: Confirm 62 Slayer before attempting any Wyrm-family variant.
Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.
Use Rada's blessing 3 or 4, fairy ring CIR, Battlefront Teleport, or Farming Guild routes for Mount Karuulm.
Unlock Bigger and Badder if superior variants are desired.
Unlock Can of Wyrms for extended 200-250 assignments.
Use Neypotzli only after partial Perilous Moons progress and Charred Island only after 60 Sailing.

methods.label: Karuulm ranged safespot
methods.summary: Attack standard Wyrms from outside direct melee range so Protect from Magic blocks all damage, or use the task-only safespot.
requiredOrKeyItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite
steps: Use the Karuulm task-only Wyrm area when on task.
Attack from outside direct melee range so standard Wyrms only use Magic.
Keep Protect from Magic active to negate all incoming damage.
Safespot idle Wyrms in the eastern alcove of the second island and lure them to the corner.
Use a 5-tick weapon such as rune crossbow or magic longbow on rapid if maintaining the safespot timing is more important than maximum DPS.
Pay attention because Wyrms can return to idle, move away, and break the safespot.
risks: Shadow Wyrm cannot be safespotted like regular Wyrms.
If a regular Wyrm moves into melee range, it can use melee and magic.

methods.label: Karuulm melee dragonbane
methods.summary: Use dragonbane or strong stab melee on standard Wyrms when accepting melee-range damage and prayer use.
prayers: Protect from Melee if melee damage is the problem
steps: Use Dragon hunter lance when available because Wyrms are draconic.
Use Noxious halberd extended range to force standard Wyrms to only use Magic while still meleeing from range.
Use strong stab weapons such as Ghrazi rapier, Osmumten's fang, or Zamorakian hasta as alternatives.
Wear required Karuulm boots unless Elite diary heat immunity applies.
Bring food and prayer restoration because direct melee range allows both melee and magic attacks.
notes: The task-page melee table notes Dragon hunter lance is especially strong against Strykewyrms in max gear.
Noxious halberd extended range also forces Lava Strykewyrms to use only ranged.

methods.label: Elemental magic
methods.summary: Use 50% earth weakness on Wyrms and Wyrmlings, or 50% water weakness on Lava and Magma Strykewyrms.
prayers: Protect from Magic for standard Wyrms at range
Protect from Missiles for Lava Strykewyrms at range
steps: Use earth spells against standard Wyrms, Shadow Wyrm, and Wyrmlings.
Use water spells against Lava Strykewyrms and Magma strykewyrms.
Stand outside melee range against standard Wyrms and pray Protect from Magic to avoid all damage.
Stand outside melee range against Lava Strykewyrms and pray Protect from Missiles.
Do not cast fire spells on Lava Strykewyrms because fire spells heal them.
Use Dragon hunter wand where available for dragonbane magic.

methods.label: Wyrmling alternative
methods.summary: Kill Wyrmlings in Neypotzli for a low-level cannon option with free local supplies, accepting weaker drops and no Shadow Wyrm spawns.
steps: Enter Neypotzli after the Perilous Moons talisman enchantment progress required for Wyrmlings to spawn.
Use the Earthbound Cavern cluster of six Wyrmlings.
Set up a dwarf multicannon for faster kills.
Use melee or earth magic against their 50% earth weakness.
Make cooked bream, cooked moss lizards, or moonlight potions inside instead of bringing many supplies.
Expect only Wyrmling bones as ordinary drops, plus Brimstone keys on Konar tasks.
risks: The task page recommends Wyrmlings only for players who do not want to bother with normal Wyrms.

methods.label: Lava Strykewyrm alternative
methods.summary: Use the 60 Sailing Charred Dungeon alternative for dragon metal sheet value, Protect from Missiles at range, and Magma strykewyrm superior access.
requiredOrKeyItems: Charred Island bank chest at 70 Construction
prayers: Protect from Melee in melee distance
steps: Reach Charred Island with 60 Sailing and deploy a rope to enter the dungeon.
Choose melee distance with Protect from Melee or attack from distance with Protect from Missiles.
Use Noxious halberd extended range if you want a melee weapon while forcing ranged-only attacks.
Use water spells to exploit the 50% water weakness.
Do not bring a cannon because Lava Strykewyrm sections cannot be cannoned.
Bring High Level Alchemy runes and a gem bag for their drop table.
For long-term killing, build the Charred Island bank chest at 70 Construction and dock a boat with a Greater teleport focus.
risks: The closest docking points are far away without a docked boat setup.

methods.label: Superior variants
methods.summary: Handle Shadow Wyrm with ranged Protect from Magic; handle Magma strykewyrm by moving from burrow attacks or safespotting.
steps: Expect Shadow Wyrm only from regular Wyrm kills, not Wyrmlings.
Fight Shadow Wyrm from range with Protect from Magic to negate all damage.
Do not rely on the regular Wyrm safespot for Shadow Wyrm.
Expect Magma strykewyrm only from Lava Strykewyrm kills.
Move away from the tile targeted by Magma strykewyrm's burrow special to avoid 20+ damage.
Safespot Magma strykewyrm by outranging its attacks if using a suitable setup; when safespotted it will not use the special attack.
risks: Magma strykewyrm's burrow special can occur even near a wall.
Shadow Wyrm has much higher stats than regular Wyrms.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use Dragon hunter lance or other strong melee weapons; Noxious halberd extended range can force ranged-only/magic-only behaviour.
